title: Why-dropped split vanishes entirely for a class whose drops are all 2.3 severed culls (no Drop_Site ever)
detail: The guard requires the split to name the severed residual or it undercounts. When a class's drops are all silent culls (demolished junction pile), the len gate hides the whole split: 'drop N' shows with no cause — the exact demolition-stranding case the residual was built for.
recommended_fix: In draw_sla_gauges, read a missing drop_reasons row as zeros (or grow rows to len(f.sla) in feed_drop_sites) so severed == dropped and the line shows '(severed K)' — every dropped class then carries a named cause.

title: Worktree _pr_body.md is the stale 5.2 story body, not the v2-visibility PR body
evidence: _pr_body.md:1: "# Story 5.2 — Node health states (per-node 🟢→🟡→🔴 surface)" — the AC3 content (gaps shipped vs deferred, Section B numbers, no-LOG_VERSION proof, terminology citations, canon amendment) exists only in /Users/moses/code/_bmad-output/perkins/packet-plumber-v2-visibility/r1/pr_body.md ("## v2-visibility: make invisible chokepoints visible in-game").
detail: The review context names the worktree _pr_body.md as 'the PR body'. If the PR-open step consumes that file, the PR ships the 5.2 body and AC3 (PR body carries the proof sections) fails despite the correct body existing in the output dir.
recommended_fix: Overwrite the worktree _pr_body.md with the output-dir pr_body.md (or point the PR-open pipeline at the output dir) before opening the PR.
